lockFileMaintenance.description: Nightly rather than the preset's weekly. This repository consumes stack4ops/pkgs, and the lock file is the only place that dependency is expressed -- the flake input tracks a branch, so there is no version string for Renovate to bump. Weekly would mean a zot release sits in pkgs' main for up to seven days before it reaches a published image. The bot's 04:17 run falls inside this window, two hours after the pkgs run.
